load_image_from_file: load an image from a file path and resize if smaller than minimum dimension
load_pdf_pages_as_images: load specific pages from a PDF file as resized RGB images
parse_page_range_string: parse a comma-separated page range string like 1,3-5,7 into a sorted list of integers
load_file_as_images: load a file as images auto-detecting whether it is a PDF or image
flatten_pdf_annotations: flatten annotations and form fields on a PDF page before rendering
